text:
Weak functional malefic = less harm? Nope.

Weakness doesn't take away a graha's energy, only its control, so the harm comes out worse. And judge that weakness by overall ṣaḍbala, not one marker.

Changed how I read weak grahas tbh ..

A bad bhāva doesn't lose its domain. You just suffer it.

Afflicted 6th: disease, debt, enemies. Strong 6th: mastery over disease, lending, even the judge and lawyer. Same house, strength decides which side you're on.

Cleaner than good/bad labels tbh ..

A brilliant chart can still live an ordinary life.

Strong lagna and lagneśa, rāja yogas between kendra and trikoṇa lords.. none of it shows if the daśās that carry them run in childhood or old age. Strength and timing have to meet.

Most underrated check tbh ..

Directional lordship isn't Digbala.

Lordship ties a graha to a direction, Maṅgala rules the south. Digbala is the strength it gets from its spot against the horizon and meridian, and Maṅgala peaks at the 10th bhāva madhya. Two different things.

Easy to mix up tbh ..
